cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: I want the HQ up to a flat. The Southwark retainer won't sign with a firm that looks like a spare room. A flat has a door that locks and somewhere a buyer will sit. And these meetings can finally leave James's workshop.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: I want us out of the studio and into a flat. Stepney pays because we deliver. Southwark pays for a firm that looks like it's staying, and a flat says staying. A studio says passing through.
